page.layout: One column of running text, with no marginal notes. Catchword at the lower right, gathering signature at the lower left.

main_text.p: & factis, totaque reipublicæ administratione collimarent, ut testatur idem Polybius, quàm ad genuinam libertatem, ac iuris æqualitatem; atque insuper comes & benigni essent erga omnes: quid mirum, si res suas cum tempore ad invidiam usque promoverint? Id verò inprimis in laudem iis cessit, & gratiam conciliavit, quòd ipsa re ostenderent, non commodis suis, sed bono publico se studere: quodque si quos societati suæ armis, aut verborum suadelà adjicerent, non imperium in eos ullum, aut superius jus usurparent, sed in reipublicæ communionem, & potestatem parem adscisserent [?]; nec id verbis solum profiterentur, sed ipsa re sine vitio præstarent. Quo nihil potest esse ad parandum sincerum favorem efficacius. In more autem habuêre à tempore instauratæ societatis, quod incidit, ut dixi, in annum tertium Olympiadis cxxiiii exeuntem, cum quo fluebat annus urbis Romæ CCCCLXXIII, præficere sibi στρατηγὸς [?] duos, quos præto-res dicimus, & his adjungere scribam unum. Atque hunc morem tenuêre per annos xxv. Post placuit, unum modò στρατηγὸν [?] creare, qui in totâ societate præstare virtute videretur: eique datum imperium annuum: sed id sæpè, prout

page.notes: The page ends mid-sentence with the catchword "prout". The Roman numeral "ccccLxxiii" is printed in mixed case; it is rendered here as CCCCLXXIII. The long s has been written as plain s throughout, so "ostenderent", "suæ" and "potest" are normalised. The Greek words are uncertain at the scan's resolution and are marked [?]. The bottom-left signature is faint and marked [?]. Small marks at the left edge are ruling or show-through, not text.
